_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Limited Maintenance Manual (Type I)
summary: Specifies format and content preparation instructions for a Limited Maintenance Manual supporting limited equipment maintenance by technicians not permitted to perform piece-part isolation, replacement, or soldering.
use_relationship:
The Limited Maintenance Manual supports limited maintenance of the equipment by technicians who are trained in the equipment logic and are not permitted to perform electronic piece-part isolation and replacement, or maintenance operations that involve soldering.

This DID contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract, and paragraphs 2-1, 3-1, 4-1, 4-2 and 5-1 of DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as stated herein. DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals, current edition, is available at the National Security Agency, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6718, Fort Meade, Md 20755-6718, and Attn: I8222.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Limited Maintenance Manual (Type I) shall be in accordance with the format and style requirements of paragraphs 2-1, 3-1, and 4-1 of DS-56.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The textbook content shall be in accordance with paragraphs 4-2 and 5-1 of DS-56. Detail or specified information concerning the cryptologic or internal cryptographic functions must not be included.
